currentSourceMetadata716.help:
Sender en offentlig e-faktura gennem Digisense' access point: validate-document (schematron) -> deliver-document -> poll til delivered, og bogfører en succes som en acknowledged PEPPOL-submission. License-key hentes fra secret-laget (config/digisense.json) — gem den først med `efaktura konfigurer`. companyKey resolves fra Digisense-state eller --digisense-company-key.

  rentemester invoice transmit-digisense --company <path> (--document-id <n> | --invoice-number <no>) --confirm yes [--digisense-company-key <key>]

  - --confirm yes: påkrævet bekræftelse; kommandoen kræver også en actor.
  - Forudsætter en gemt license-key (`efaktura konfigurer --api-license-key ...`) og en registreret virksomhed (`efaktura registrer`).

  --document-id

All JSON writes exact single application/json case-insensitive (no charset), absent content-encoding, max16384 bytes; query presence (even ?) refused except imported exact raw asOf=YYYY-MM-DD; imported refuses idempotency-key. No universal key header.

variants.when: Server-authoritative original status constructor: acknowledged/acceptedfailed true, pending false withfullcanonicalnativeevidence, not newdelivery.
Missing/invalid signed cookie or forbidden Authorization/service key
Query, framing, media, encoding or leaf grammar refused
Other NotCommitted application refusal; source code/message preserved
OutcomeUnknown/retired/nonreusable phases; public maps code outcome_unknown, mailbox maps internal

binary.description: JSON transports; exports carry UTF8 XML/envelope string with SHA256. Original CLI may publish exact verified UTF8 artifact locally, no binary HTTP media download. Receive retains EML/attachment originals on server, not returned raw credentials or bytes.

contracts.paginationFilterOrder: No public query/pagination parameters. Submissions every row ordered by invoiceDocumentId, blocking rows first (redeliveryBlocked!=false), then id. Native events id ascending; preserve all immutable rows.

revisionConfirmationCapabilities.authority: Fresh currenthuman/CompanyExternalSend and sameadmittedtransaction currentregisteredcompanykey optionalassertion. Servertrimsoptionalkey; blankmeansnoexplicitassertion butownbindingmandatory. physical() source/outbound/binding and subject/permissions rechecked afterproviderread. NativeStatus unchanged.
revisionConfirmationCapabilities.revision: No caller expectedRevision or generated hash. Current source hashes/namespace/frozen invoice facts, registration identity and credential generation rechecked between provider phases. No Owner lock/SQL transaction spans provider network call.
revisionConfirmationCapabilities.confirmation: Reads/advisory none. Native writes require outer CLI/MCP confirmation and exact inner confirm:true only where body schema declares it; mail config/alias body has no inner confirmation; delete has no body. Original export selectors no confirmation; metadata prepare confirm built by original CLI; transmit --confirm yes. Direct HTTP has no outer confirm flag.
revisionConfirmationCapabilities.atomicity: No new posting/settlement by selected public export/send/receive/read/validation operations. OIOUBL export and metadata handoff audit SQL, registration partial phases and receive document/retention/dedup stages can write. Mail configuration file publish/remove precedes audit SQL commit; not a single file+SQL rollback promise. Current backup/transfer/period/scanner/source-byte gates remain; uncertain delivery reservation stays durable. No universal no-effects on preview/refusal.

key.explanation: No caller retry/idempotency key on this selected operation; provider/metadata natural identity is not an HTTP retry promise.

retry.scope: Current selected company/ledger/source/principal/permission, not cross-company or changed-authority recovery; workspace receive preflights all active initialized targets before effects.

retry.tombstone: No caller-key tombstone API; retained historical submission/dedup records continue blocking as source requires. Configuration deletion invalidates poll admission, not old evidence.

metadata.description: DocumentMetadata-payload (uden 'source') der anvendes på vedhæftningerne — se examples/bilagsmail.metadata.json

accountingRationale.description: Required for internal_voucher: the accounting reason for the posting.

amountIncVat.description: Total amount including VAT, in kroner (decimal DKK, 2 decimals — NOT øre).

danishSimplifiedPurchaseInvoice.description: Explicit source fact: this is a Danish simplified purchase invoice. This never changes recipient invoice fields.

deliveryDescription.description: Free-text description of the goods or services.

exemptionCode.description: Set to 'FOREIGN_PHYSICAL_ONLY' for a foreign physical-only receipt; otherwise omit.

invoiceNo.description: Invoice or receipt number printed on the document.

purchaseVatLines.description: Optional durable purchase VAT split. Its net and VAT totals must reconcile exactly with the document totals.

vatAmount.description: VAT amount in kroner; 25% for dk_purchase_25, otherwise zero.

countryCode.description: Supplier ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country evidence, e.g. 'US'. Required with identifierKind.

identifierKind.description: Typed supplier identifier. non_eu permits no identifier when country evidence is non-EU.

vatOrCvr.description: Party VAT or CVR number, e.g. 'DK12345678'.

reverseChargeWordingConfirmed.description: True only when a human has confirmed that the supplier invoice contains reverse-charge wording; required with the other invoice evidence before non-EU input-VAT deduction.

countryCode.description: Supplier ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country evidence, e.g. 'US'. Required with identifierKind.

identifierKind.description: Typed supplier identifier. non_eu permits no identifier when country evidence is non-EU.

vatOrCvr.description: Party VAT or CVR number, e.g. 'DK12345678'.

sourceBankTransactionId.description: Required for internal_voucher: the imported bank transaction that is its primary evidence.

vatAmount.description: VAT amount, in kroner (decimal DKK, 2 decimals — NOT øre).

sourceMetadata.description: Sender en udstedt faktura eller en betalingspåmindelse til kundens email via SMTP med PDF'en vedhæftet, og logger afsendelsen append-only. SMTP-config læses fra config/smtp.json; credentials gemmes aldrig i bogføringstilstanden. Idempotent: en identisk afsendelse genudsendes ikke.
sourceMetadata.help:
Sender en udstedt faktura eller en betalingspåmindelse til kundens email via SMTP med PDF'en vedhæftet, og logger afsendelsen append-only. SMTP-config læses fra config/smtp.json; credentials gemmes aldrig i bogføringstilstanden. Idempotent: en identisk afsendelse genudsendes ikke.

Brug:
  rentemester invoice send --company <path> (--document-id <n> | --invoice-number <no>) [--kind invoice|reminder] [--to <email>]

Inputnoter:
  - SMTP-config (host, port, fromAddress, fromName, dryRun) læses fra config/smtp.json
  - Den indbyggede SMTP-transport er DRY-RUN: den validerer og logger afsendelsen, men sender ingen rigtig email. Reel levering kræver en ekstern SMTP-integration — afsendelsen markeres derfor i loggen, ikke i kundens indbakke.
  - --to overstyrer modtageren; ellers slås kundens email op fra kundekartoteket
  - --kind reminder kræver at fakturaen er udstedt; standard er invoice

  --company
  --document-id
  --invoice-number
  --kind
  --to
  --help
  --format
  --json
  --actor
  --actor-via

sourceMetadata.description: Poller modtagne e-fakturaer hos Digisense (list-received-documents), følger pagination, og ingester hvert NYT dokument via den eksisterende ingest-pipeline. Dedup på Digisense' stabile internalId gør gentaget poll idempotent. Et uingesterbart dokument (validering/dublet) sættes i karantæne, så det ikke down­loades + fejler igen. Partiel succes: én dårlig faktura fælder ikke de øvrige. Skrivende handling — kræver '--confirm yes' og en actor (symmetrisk med MCP).
sourceMetadata.help:

Inputnoter:
  - --confirm yes: påkrævet bekræftelse (skrivende poll, symmetrisk med MCP-tool'et).
  - --digisense-company-key: companyKey at polle fra; standard den ENE registrerede virksomhed.
  - --limit: side-størrelse (<=100); standard 100.

  - --force: tillad ingest af en logisk dublet (samme afsender + fakturanr.).
